title: 第15章 南赡部洲第16章 村中留宿
content_zh:
几天后。
南赡部洲，海边。
一条银色蛟龙拖着一张小木筏，抵达岸边。
敖正回头看向陆生和孙悟空，一指岸边道：
“上了岸便是南赡部州。”
“龙族不宜上岸，我就不送你们了。”
陆生感谢道：
“这一路，多谢十三太子了！”
“日后若有机会，定再相谢！”
敖正摇了摇头：
“说什么感谢。”
“你们二人救了本太子一命，这本就是本太子该做的事。”
说完。
敖正化身银发少年，将一物递给了陆生。
“此物你留在身边。”
陆生接过来一看。
那是一只银色海螺。
“十三太子，这是何物？”
陆生问道。
他自然认到出，这是一只海螺。

但既然是敖正送出。
那就不可能是一只普通的海螺。
敖正解释道：
“此乃我的伴生宝物。”
“无论你们在何处，只要遇到危险，便可用此物召唤我！”
陆生闻言，推辞道：
“十三太子，此宝太过贵重，我……”
不等陆生的话说完。
敖正便摇头打断：
“你们救了本太子一命。”
“本太子只是送了你们一程，这自然还不足以报恩。”
“这只海螺，你且收下吧！”
“若你们不愿收下，我只能一路跟随你们了。”
见敖正态度如此坚定。
陆生心中也对这位十三太子生出一丝敬意。
对方行事，确实磊落！
陆生不再犹豫，收起那枚海螺，郑重道：
content_en:
A few days later.
Nanfanbuzhou, seaside.
A silver dragon dragged a small raft to the shore.
Ao Zheng turned back to look at Lu Sheng and Sun Wukong, pointed to the shore and said:
"When you get ashore, you'll find Nanfangbu Prefecture."
"It's not appropriate for dragons to come ashore, so I won't send you off."
Lu Sheng thanked:
"Thank you very much, Prince Thirteen, for this journey!"
"If there is an opportunity in the future, I will thank you again!"
Ao Zheng shook his head:
"Say thank you."
"You two saved my prince's life. This is what I should do."
Finished.
Ao Zheng transformed into a silver-haired boy and handed something to Lu Sheng.
"Keep this thing with you."
Lu Sheng took it and took a look.
It was a silver conch.
"Thirteenth Prince, what is this?"
Lu Sheng asked.
He naturally recognized that it was a conch.
But since it was sent by Ao Zheng.
It couldn't be an ordinary conch.
Ao Zheng explained:
"This is my companion treasure."
"No matter where you are, whenever you encounter danger, you can use this thing to summon me!"
Hearing this, Lu Sheng declined and said:
"Thirteenth Prince, this treasure is too precious, I..."
He didn't wait for Lu Sheng to finish his words.
Ao Zheng shook his head and interrupted:
"You saved my prince's life."
"My prince just gave you a ride, so naturally this is not enough to repay your kindness."
"Please accept this conch!"
"If you are unwilling to accept it, I will have no choice but to follow you all the way."
Seeing Ao Zheng's attitude is so firm.
Lu Sheng also felt a sense of respect for the Thirteenth Prince.
The other party acted honestly and honestly!
Lu Sheng no longer hesitated, put away the conch, and said solemnly:
